name: Canadian Soil Quality Benchmark System
description: A national benchmark/monitoring system defining metrics and reference data for assessing soil quality across Canada.
evaluation_method: composite_score (combination of RMSE for continuous indicators, accuracy/F1 for categorical classes, and spatial/temporal consistency metrics)
reputation: Widely used within Canadian soil science and environmental monitoring communities as a national reference for soil-quality metrics and long-term monitoring.
notes: Non-LLM environmental benchmark with heterogeneous tasks (both regression and classification); strong spatial and temporal heterogeneity across regions; large-scale but unevenly labeled data in some regions; policy/privacy constraints for raw location-linked data.
